links.comparator_used: Default prompt with no specific instructions versus low-literacy prompt (write at a sixth-grade level)
links.outcome: Ateşman Readability Index score of AI-generated Turkish dermatology patient education texts
links.effect: Prompting significantly improved ChatGPT readability (p < 0.001); no significant change for Gemini, already high by default. Prompted Gemini had the highest mean score (68.98 ± 4.66). Default Gemini 66.63 vs default ChatGPT 62.66 (p = 0.004).
links.quote: While specific prompting significantly improved ChatGPT performance (p < 0.001), no significant change was observed in Gemini scores, which were already high in the default condition.

links.comparator_used: Original Turkish Dermatology Association brochures (68 PEMs)
links.outcome: Ateşman Readability Index score of AI-generated texts vs original brochures
links.effect: TDA brochures mean 59.08 ± 5.80 (medium difficulty); all four AI groups scored significantly higher (p < 0.05), with effect sizes r = 0.242 to 0.753.
links.quote: All AI-generated groups demonstrated significantly higher readability scores compared with the TDA brochures (p < 0.05).
